svg.title: Driving frequency as a function of inverse measured wavelength
svg.desc: mode 2: f = 343 Hz, λ = 1.010 m; mode 3: f = 514.5 Hz, λ = 0.670 m; mode 4: f = 686 Hz, λ = 0.500 m; mode 5: f = 857.5 Hz, λ = 0.402 m. Air temperature: 22.8 °C. Least-squares fit through the origin: f = v / λ, v = 344.33 m/s, centred R² = 0.999914.
